purpose: Define and test the parser-independent conditional-choice estimator and performance-label permutation engine using synthetic data only.

canonical_choice_table.one_row_per: individual first-breeding event x candidate colony
canonical_choice_table.chosen_rule: Exactly one chosen=1 row per event.
canonical_choice_table.candidate_count: At least 2 and at most 3 Ross Island colonies per event.

model.family: conditional multinomial logit with individual first-breeding event as stratum
model.linear_predictor: beta_perf * performance_state + beta_natal * natal_colony_indicator + beta_size * log1p_colony_size
model.estimator: Newton-Raphson maximum conditional likelihood using analytic gradient and information matrix

convergence.singular_information: use Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse and flag rank deficiency; do not drop a covariate based on outcome

permutation.rule: For each Monte Carlo replicate and each performance year independently, uniformly permute the three Ross colony performance labels CROZ, ROYD, BIRD. Candidate-set membership, chosen colony, natal indicator, colony size and missingness remain fixed.
permutation.years_with_incomplete_three_colony_perfo: Events from those years are ineligible before model fitting under ROSS_ISLAND_BANDED_BREEDER_PERFORMANCE_V1.
permutation.refit: Refit the full three-covariate conditional logit for every replicate.
permutation.p_value: (1 + number of null beta_perf >= observed beta_perf) / (B + 1)

information_gate.destination_requirement: At least two distinct chosen Ross colonies.
information_gate.failure: STOP before fitting the observed model or permutations.

synthetic_tests_required: recover positive performance preference from simulated two/three-option choices
recover near-zero performance coefficient when choices are generated independently of performance
permutation preserves chosen outcomes, candidate sets, natal indicator and size while changing only performance labels
all rows for the same performance year use one common colony-label permutation within a replicate
reject events with zero/multiple chosen alternatives
loader_boundary: No real resight CSV loader is implemented or invoked until the exact CSV header is retrieved under the schema-only gate.
The real-data parser may map documented raw columns into this canonical choice table but may not change the model, candidate-set definition, covariates, permutation or minimum-information rule.
